closed_coherent_action: S_closed=integral d tau [P_mu dot X^mu+p_phi dot phi+i z^dagger D_tau z-H_pair(Xi)-H_cm-H_phi-z^dagger H_wake z-H_cross]-sum_k G_k delta(tau-tau_k)
fixed_pair: Xi_AB is selected at inception and D_tau Xi_AB=0
mandatory_cross_term: H_cross or G_k must depend jointly on collective motion/environment and the wake variables; otherwise a common-mode push cannot alter flavor response
mass_readout: physical mass remains a parent-relative complete-cycle Hamiltonian/Floquet quasi-energy, not an instantaneous wake label
open_branch: S_closed must be enlarged by environment/radiation degrees of freedom before a reduced many-to-one reset map is permitted
